high_level_description: The image shows a close-up of an Amazfit Active smartwatch placed on a textured surface, likely a table or desk. The watch has a black strap with a buckle at the end and a circular face with multiple buttons around its edge. The screen is off, and the watch appears to be in good condition. The text above the image describes the comfort of the straps, mentioning that they are comfortable to wear even after sweating and can be interchanged. It also notes that the waterproof design allows users to use the smartwatch while swimming.
